items.title: FCC批准SpaceX最多部署100万颗数据中心卫星
items.summary: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）周三宣布，已授权SpaceX部署最多100万颗搭载AI芯片的卫星，作为马斯克旗下公司“Starmind”计划的一部分。谷歌和蓝色起源等也在探索太空AI数据中心，这是该机构首次批准此类项目。
items.lede: FCC首次批准太空AI数据中心项目，SpaceX获准部署最多100万颗搭载AI芯片的卫星。
analysis: FCC周三宣布授权SpaceX部署最多100万颗搭载AI芯片的卫星，属于“Starmind”计划。
这是FCC首次批准太空AI数据中心项目，谷歌和蓝色起源等也在探索类似想法。

en.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to deploy up to 1 million data center satellites
en.summary: The FCC announced Wednesday that it has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites equipped with AI chips as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative. Google and Blue Origin are also exploring the idea of AI data centers in space; this is the agency's first approval of such a project.
en.lede: The FCC has approved its first space-based AI data center project, allowing SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites equipped with AI chips.
analysis: The FCC announced Wednesday that it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites equipped with AI chips under its "Starmind" initiative.
This is the FCC's first approval of a space-based AI data center project, with Google and Blue Origin also exploring similar ideas.

items.title: 新测试显示：最强AI助手也难可靠完成日常事务
items.summary: 一项新测试发现，即便最先进的AI模型，在完成日常任务时也难以做到可靠、安全，还可能带来新问题。
items.lede: 一项新测试显示，最先进的AI助手在日常事务上仍不够可靠。
analysis: 研究团队发布了一项新测试，用来衡量AI助手处理日常事务的能力。
结果显示，即使最先进的模型也难以稳定、安全地完成任务，有时还会引入新问题。
这提醒用户，把日常事务交给个人AI助手时仍需谨慎。

en.title: New benchmark: even top AI agents struggle with everyday tasks
en.summary: A new benchmark finds that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely, and can introduce new problems.

analysis: Researchers released a new benchmark that measures how well AI assistants handle everyday tasks.
Even the most advanced models struggled to finish tasks reliably and safely, and sometimes introduced new problems.
The findings suggest users should still be cautious about handing daily chores to personal AI assistants.
